release_notes:
Extend localization to all supported languages (menu + labels)

Added menu/UI translations for every supported language (now 15: Spanish, French,
German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Romanian, Dutch, Chinese Simplified,
Hungarian, Swedish, Vietnamese, Lithuanian, Farsi) in the admin menu translation
layer (menu_i18n.php), so the side/top menu localizes for all of them.

Re-ran the label backfill translator across all 15 languages: labels whose English
value maps to a menu term are now translated (only where still an untranslated English
fallback, so existing translations are preserved). Languages that previously had the
most gaps (Dutch, Swedish) gained ~90 translated labels each. Remaining untranslated
labels keep the English fallback.
